Results.ReviewText: 30+ years Weber enthusiast.  This grill is an evolution from my original Smoky Joe. The earlier versions of the Kettle and Gas grill experiences were great too.  Very happy with this buy.
Results.Title: Time marches on.  Weber is evolving.

Results.ReviewText: Easier to use and worth the cost over the more basic model.
Results.Title: Love it.

Results.ReviewText: Tres hureux de mon achat...je conaissait le.produit donc pas surpris des pefomances...par contre heureux de la facilité du montage...
Results.Title: Efficience et durabilité

Results.ReviewText: well done, as a second generation weber man I love the ash catcher and the ease of emptying the ash, I also love the lid holder and the addition of the thermometer, only wish the center grate stayed put when you hang the grate to lite the grill.
Results.Title: Well Done

Results.ReviewText: It is a great product and a pleasure to grill with!!!!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: A classic grill.  I really got it for the upgraded grill grate and charcoal baskets.  Totally worth it.
Results.Title: Master Touch 22” is worth it.

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill! You can tell the durability of the grill as soon as you open the box.  The ease of use is as always present in a Weber. The GBS is a nice new feature for me that I am truly enjoying.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: I would give 5 stars except for the instructions to assemble it.  They are horrible.  No part descriptions, only picture of the assembled grill means you can't just walk into a hardware store asking for a specific part if you don't know the name of it or the size.  Not everyone is a young, handy male.  Some of us are old women who never assembled tools before.  Together now and looks beautiful.
Results.Title: Weber 22" grill

Results.ReviewText: This is really a great grill with the basics, I got it on sale at $150 and it was totally worth it. Ive had it for few months but quality features and design are at least excellent!!
Results.Title: GREAT PARTNER FOR FAMILY TIME! :)

Results.ReviewText:
Love it!
Been using the 22 inch of over 50 years!
This is my 5th and the best one yet!
Results.Title: The Best!!

Results.ReviewText: It is easy to assemble and easy to use.   The features make grilling fun and simple. I hate cleaning grills, the added pan saves a lot of cleaning time.  I highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Master Touch Charcoal Grill 22 inch

ClientResponses.Response: Hi Kevin, we are very sorry to hear about this damages on your new grill. This is definitely not we would expect from our manufacturing team! However it looks like you were able to get hold of our support team and found a solution. If there is anything outstanding please be sure to let our support team know! We will be happy to help!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill at Lowes, and when I opened up the box the top of the grill was severely dented and the finish was messed up. The box had no damage so it was likely packaged damaged. Very disappointing. I am having a very hard time getting ahold of customer service.
Results.Title: Purchased grill at lowes - Damaged grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned numerous Weber Gas Grills over the years.  I recently moved and opted for a charcoal grill because I miss that flavor in the foods I prepare!  The Master Touch 22” is fantastic; it’s easy to use and the burgers and steaks are top notch!!!
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch 22” Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent.   Our first charcoal grill.  Up and running in about 10 to 15 minutes with the chimney starter.  Nice lid storage and opening grate.  I knew it would not come with a side table but that could be nice.  Little wobble in the legs but very nice.
Results.Title: Excellent first Weber first charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: The instructions that come with it are a bit confusing, it is a lot easier if you download Weber app and follow online instructions there!
Results.Title: Love the grill, assembly a bit confusing

Results.ReviewText: This kettle can do it all! It's going along side my original 22 (learned everything I know on that bad boy). Now I just need to convince the wife to let me get the 26 lol
Results.Title: Brisket or Hotdogs?

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill and very good quality. Received as promised
Results.Title: Good quality grill

Results.ReviewText: I love it especially the easy cleaning of the ash.
Results.Title: Love It

ClientResponses.Response: Hello! Congratulations on your new grill! We are sorry to see that the bowl has some chipped enamel, but we have reached out via email to offer some help. Thank you.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Disappointed that the one leg had to have the protective enamel sanded away and fixed before it was even shipped to us.   This grill is definitely cheaper looking and feeling then I would expect for the price I paid.  The legs are so chincy it worries me.   I would of expected this craftsmanship from a 60 dollar grill.   I am disappointed in the quality.   But I does still cook well.   I just don’t expect it to last long.
Results.Title: Disappointing craftsmanship

Results.ReviewText: Great Quality Durability . Nothing can beat a Weber Kettle
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Grill on the Market

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Master-Touch Kettle is a convenient and versatile cooking tool. Whether you are grilling up some steaks quick or smoking a pork shoulder for an extended period of time. The Weber Master-Touch does the job and it does it well. Not to mention clean up is easy, and moving it around the yard is easy too. Solid product I’m glad I purchased.
Results.Title: Versatility

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is built to last! Every element is is constructed of the most durable materials and will stay new looking for years with routine maintenance. 
The Large grill surface and elevated rack provided limitless options fo temperature control and offset cooking.
Results.Title: Durable and beautiful.

Results.ReviewText: Très bon rapport qualité prix et très très performant !
Results.Title: Très fonctionnel

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! The grill is well made with features built in that I didn't know about when I purchased. The best feature I like is it's stainless grill grate. It is a lot easier to clean than a cast grate.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill. First grill i buy myself and i love it. its big and sturdy. It is easy to use and ergonomic.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: This was one of my best purchases, the GBS is awesome got the Wok, Pizza Stone and Beer Can chicken set up and couldn’t be more impressed with the quality of cooking im doing for the family during these times.
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: Maintains heat well..Do not be scared of cooking with charcoal.
Results.Title: Ease of use

Results.ReviewText: Cooks like an oven, just keep the lid on and always remember to preheat. Great grill.
Results.Title: Be the master of the grill with the Master-Touch

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your feedback. We are sorry to hear about your grill grates. If you would like we do have non GBS (Gourmet Bbq System) grill grates available for our 22" charcoal grills. If you don't like your removable round center you can use our normal grill grates #7441 with your grill!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I like everything about the grill except for the grate. The round removable center is a real pain when it comes to brushing/cleaning the grate. The center will pop out and fall into the grill with minimal brushing force. The blue color is really nice, lid holder is great, and ash catcher works really nice.
Results.Title: Great grill except for grate

Results.ReviewText: Je les acheté le mois dernier et je suis super content de toute les options que je peux faire avec mon bbq
Results.Title: Un des meilleurs bbq au charbon

Results.ReviewText: Sold my Slate Blue Master Touch to purchase the Deep Ocean Blue. So glad I did. I absolutely love the color. Seasoned it in today with a couple hickory chunks. The installation was pretty simple.
Results.Title: Beautiful grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hello Matt, Congratulations on your new grill! We are very sorry to hear this! We have reached out to you have your handle shipped out to you. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I like the grill, but the product was missing the bowl handle assembly completely. Not a huge problem, my grill just doesn’t have a handle that is heat resistant. I tried to contact Weber to order the part, but never heard a response.
Results.Title: Reliable grill. Unreliable service.

Results.ReviewText: Used 4X and all I can say is I'm very satisfied with how well it maintains temps and cooks. Only negative would be the legs are made of very thin tubing which was kind of a surprise since I've always heard good things about Weber Quality.
Results.Title: Cooks as advertised

Results.ReviewText: For the money it’s well worth it.  Need to have one more for all the families requests at once.  So easy to use in so many ways.
Results.Title: Old school grilling at its best!

Results.ReviewText: I couldn’t be happier with this grill. I would go into how convenient the lid holder is, or how the ash catcher keeps the patio tidy, etc, but the only thing that truly matters is the food, and this grill has never disappointed in that department. Burgers, Ribs, Boston Butts, Shrimp, Chicken, you name it, when it comes off this grill it’s going to be exceptional.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText:
Beyond expectations, temperature management easier then expected, 
Have grilled burgers, chicken and steaks, smoked turkey and pork shoulder to perfection.
Results.Title: Out of the ballpark

Results.ReviewText: très satisfait de mon achat je le recommande et quelle belle initiative d'avoir fait un programme sur internet pour l’assemblage étape par étape simplement Wow
Results.Title: super content  de l'efficacité du weber

Results.ReviewText: I use to have one a long time ago, but never knew how to truly use it. Since purchasing one again, I’ve watched a lot of YouTube gathering as much information as possible to use my Weber 22” Kettle to its fullest potential. I have not been disappointed with my purchase. Grill on every chance I get since we are on lockdown due to the Corona Virus.
Results.Title: Learning new tips on my Weber 22”!!!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill!  We have cooked several chickens & pork butts on this grill the end result did not disappoint.  Highly recommend!
Results.Title: B

Results.ReviewText: Great kettle. Exactly what you expect from Weber. Classic styling. Easy to put together. Easy to use.  Tasty results.
Results.Title: Exactly what you expect from a Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Very high quality unit and the ocean blue is vibrant!   I really like the ash catcher. A much cleaner solution than the old pan style that I used to have.
Results.Title: Happy in Minneapolis

Results.ReviewText: Great kettle, for me it’s the perfect height for grilling. I love being able to switch the grates out for that complete grilling solution. I also bought the rotisserie which is awesome.
Results.Title: Blue 22

Results.ReviewText: I bought my first grill and I love my Weber .I can’t wait to use it again .My steaks came out perfect.
Results.Title: Great Features

Results.ReviewText: I have always owned a Weber grill of some kind, but the Master Touch is the best. All the advanced features to make grilling and smoking a pleasure.  I only wish I could afford the accessories for the center of the grill. Being able to make stir fry on a grill... are you kidding me.  Love my new grill and I know I will get endless hours of great fun making new and delicious recipes.  Everyone should own a Weber charcoal grill in there life time.
Results.Title: Not a better charcoal grill in the world.

Results.ReviewText: We have enjoyed the extra room provided by the top rack. The built in thermometer is a great feature. We have an 18 inch Weber charcoal grill and this is a significant upgrade. We are happy with our purchase
Results.Title: Extra room

ClientResponses.Response: Hi Robert, Congrats on your new grill! Thank you for your time to provide us with your feedback. We will pass this information to our development team. Make sure you register your grill it comes with a generous warranty! We hope you get many great memories and meals off it! If you have any other questions please contact us at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Grill seems ok, but the legs are alarmingly thin and cheap feeling. We’ll see how they hold up. The upper seems of good quality though.
Results.Title: Seems ok

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
